    Constructor
    Description
     
    DifferentialDriveOdometry(Encoder leftEncoder, Encoder rightEncoder, DirectionFinder direction, DriveGeometry geometry, Pose pose)
    Creates odometry that updates pose in place, with the heading from direction, such as a GyroHeading: thousandths of a degree, followed between updates, and a valid sample on every update.
     
    DifferentialDriveOdometry(Encoder leftEncoder, Encoder rightEncoder, Gyroscope gyro, DriveGeometry geometry, Pose pose)
    Creates odometry that updates pose in place, with the heading from gyro's angle: whole degrees, read once each DifferentialDriveOdometry.update(), and no sample while the angle reads negative.
